column2: Validate the Zenith Buildtech Online Enquiry Form for field validation, mandatory fields, boundary conditions, successful submission and Clear button functionality.

column3: Verify the enquiry form accepts valid values in all mandatory and optional fields and submits successfully.
column4:
1. Open the Zenith Buildtech Online Enquiry Form.
2. Enter valid values in Name, Company Name, Address, City, Pin Code, Phone No, Email and Message.
3. Click SEND.
4. Observe the next page.
column5:
Name: Srivatsav Reddy
Company Name: Zenith Buildtech
Address: 123 Main Road
City: Hyderabad
Pin Code: 500001
Phone No: 9876543210
Email: srivatsav@example.com
Message: I would like details about constructing a residence.
column6: All valid values should be accepted. On clicking SEND, the application should navigate to the next page and display “Enquiry Sent”.

column3: Verify Name mandatory validation when the Name field is left blank.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Leave Name blank.
3. Fill all other mandatory fields with valid values.
4. Click SEND.
5. Observe the validation message.
column5:
Name: Blank
Address: 123 Main Road
Phone: 9876543210
Email: valid@example.com
Message: Valid enquiry message
column6: The application should not submit the form and should display an appropriate error message indicating that Name is mandatory.
column7: Application did not display an error message when Name was blank and the form was submitted.

column3: Verify Name field using Boundary Value Analysis for maximum length of 30 alphabetic characters.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Enter a 30-character alphabetic Name.
3. Verify it is accepted.
4. Replace it with a 31-character alphabetic Name.
5. Verify the 31-character value is rejected or prevented.
6. Submit with otherwise valid data.
column5:
Boundary values:
Name = 30 alphabetic characters
Name = 31 alphabetic characters
column6: 30 alphabetic characters should be accepted. A 31-character Name should be rejected, restricted or an appropriate validation message should be displayed.

column3: Verify Address mandatory validation and maximum length of 500 alphanumeric characters.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Leave Address blank and attempt submission with other mandatory fields valid.
3. Enter an Address containing exactly 500 allowed alphanumeric characters.
4. Enter an Address containing 501 characters.
5. Observe validation.
column5:
Address = Blank
Address = 500 allowed characters
Address = 501 characters
column6: Blank Address should trigger a mandatory-field error. 500 allowed characters should be accepted. 501 characters should be rejected/restricted with appropriate validation.

column3: Verify Phone No accepts only a valid 10-digit numeric mobile number.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.
3. Verify it is accepted.
4. Test an alphanumeric value and an 11-digit numeric value.
5. Click SEND and observe validation.
column6: A valid 10-digit mobile number should be accepted. Non-numeric and incorrect-length values should be rejected with an appropriate error message.

column3: Verify Pin Code/Zip Code accepts only numeric values of exactly 6 digits.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Enter a 6-digit numeric Pin Code.
3. Test a 5-digit value, 7-digit value and alphabetic/alphanumeric value.
4. Observe validation.
column6: Only exactly 6 numeric digits should be accepted. Values with fewer/more digits or non-numeric characters should be rejected.

column3: Verify Email mandatory field accepts only a valid email format.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Enter a valid email address.
3. Verify it is accepted.
4. Replace it with an invalid email format such as user@ or user.com.
5. Click SEND and observe validation.
column5:
Valid: srivatsav@example.com
Invalid: srivatsav@
Invalid: srivatsav.com
column6: A valid email format should be accepted. Invalid email formats should be rejected and an appropriate validation message should be displayed.
column7: Application accepted an invalid email format.

column3: Verify Company Name and City accept only their specified character types and maximum lengths.
column4:
1. Enter a valid alphanumeric Company Name and alphabetic City.
2. Verify both are accepted.
3. Test Company Name with 100 characters and then 101 characters.
4. Test City with 100 alphabetic characters and then 101 characters.
5. Test invalid character types where applicable.
column5:
Company Name: ZenithBuildtech123
Company length: 100 / 101 characters
City: Hyderabad
City length: 100 / 101 alphabetic characters
column6: Company Name should accept alphanumeric values up to 100 characters only. City should accept alphabetic values up to 100 characters only. Values outside these rules should be rejected/restricted.

column3: Verify Message is mandatory and supports alphanumeric values with special characters up to 2000 words.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Leave Message blank and submit with other mandatory fields valid.
3. Enter a valid message containing alphanumeric and special characters.
4. Test a message of exactly 2000 words and then more than 2000 words.
5. Observe validation.
column5:
Message: Blank
Message: Valid text with letters, numbers and special characters
Boundary: 2000 words
Invalid: 2001 words
column6: Blank Message should trigger a mandatory-field error. Valid content including special characters should be accepted up to 2000 words. More than 2000 words should be rejected/restricted.

column3: Verify CLEAR button erases all data entered in the enquiry form.
column4:
1. Open the enquiry form.
2. Enter valid data in every field.
3. Click CLEAR.
4. Observe all form fields.
column5: Populate Name, Company Name, Address, City, Pin Code, Phone No, Email and Message with valid values.
column6: All data entered by the user should be erased and the form fields should return to their initial/blank state.
